global: This is spicy ramen with a vibrant, glossy red broth. Chashu pork rests atop bean sprouts and a chili paste mound, all in a white bowl with Japanese script, set on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and warm lighting reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, featuring black Japanese characters and subtle orange stain along rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, chili paste, and green onion, glossy surface reflecting light.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with golden-brown sear and pinkish-white meat, irregularly shaped with visible fat layers.
